description: Gemma 4 E4B (also 'latest'): small, fast, multimodal (image+audio) local model for trivial tasks.
notes: NOT INSTALLED: pull with `ollama pull gemma4:e4b`. Download 6.6-9.5GB (7.52B (effective 4B), Q4_K_M default tag), needs ~9GB RAM plus KV cache; fits the 48GB M4 Max. Library context 128K; limit set to 131072 because Ollama sizes context from VRAM (assumes OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH raised). Gemma 4 model card: LiveCodeBench v6 52.0% for E4B vs 77.1% for 26B-A4B (carded 5.0) -> ~3.8. Q4 quantization already accounted for. Latency estimated for M4 Max 48GB by scaling measured gemma4:26b (78 tok/s, ~4B active) by active-weight bytes; not measured. Thinking is on by default: pass think=false for fast answers. Default 'latest' tag. Audio input supported by Ollama but not modeled in card modalities. Page checked 2026-10-25.
